_comment: Scripted offline answers for the dry run. A rule matches when its 'match' text appears in an item's sanitized title; the first matching rule wins. 'independent' is 'all', 'first' (the earliest item) or a list of title fragments; 'link_to' names the summary of an existing event candidate to link to. Usage numbers are typical token counts so the spend guard is exercised.
